name: get_target_cache_loc
description: Builds target and free cache-location lists for speculative verification. out_cache_loc is viewed as [bs,num_verify_tokens]; for each row b, target takes columns < num_correct_drafts[b]+1 in order, and free takes columns >= num_verify_tokens-to_free_num_slots[b] in order. Returns two 1-D int tensors backed by an internal buffer, with a zero sentinel for an empty list and for bs==0. out_cache_loc is read-only. Current tests exercise int64 with bs 1..256 and num_verify_tokens 4..16.
